item.subject: libghostty-vt — Ghostty's core as a library
item.quote: Fetches and builds libghostty-vt.a from ghostty sources via Zig by default. Set GHOSTTY_SOURCE_DIR to use a local checkout, GHOSTTY_ZIG_SYSTEM_DIR for pre-fetched Zig packages, and LIBGHOSTTY_VT_SYS_OPTIMIZE to control optimisation.
